teks: Gambaran besar (H4): emas bergerak dalam saluran menurun (descending channel) sejak 12 Nov, dari sekitar 3920 turun ke 3500.
Harga lantun dari dasar saluran (≈3500) dan kini berada berhampiran garis atas saluran (≈3640–3680), yang bertindak sebagai rintangan.
H1: SUPPLY H1 (3672.36–3691.25) bertembung dengan garis atas saluran. Harga sudah ditolak dua kali dari kawasan ini.
DEMAND H1 (3599.50–3613.38) berada di bawah. Harga sekarang 3621.09 dan sedang menghampiri zon ini.
Jika DEMAND H1 bertahan, harga boleh lantun semula ke arah SUPPLY H1. Jika candle H1 tutup di bawah 3599.50, saluran menurun berkemungkinan bersambung ke arah 3550–3500.
teks_en: The big picture on the four hour chart: gold has been moving inside a descending channel since the twelfth of November, falling from around 3920 to 3500.
Price bounced from the bottom of the channel, near 3500, and is now close to the upper channel line, around 3640 to 3680, which acts as resistance.
On the one hour chart, the H1 supply zone, 3672.36 to 3691.25, lines up with the upper channel line. Price has been rejected twice from this area.
The H1 demand zone, 3599.50 to 3613.38, sits below. Price is now 3621.09 and is moving toward this zone.
If H1 demand holds, price can bounce back toward H1 supply. If an H1 candle closes below 3599.50, the descending channel may continue toward 3550 to 3500.
